text_block_list.text:
One day.
I accompanied Mejiro McQueen to a filming
session for a famous TV program.

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text: —On "The Way of Running," today's guest is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My name is... Mejiro McQueen.
It is truly a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Mejiro, they're the household everyone knows!
The episode featuring the head of the family, whom McQueen-san reveres, had the highest ratings in history!

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Showing a side of yourself you don't usually see caused quite a stir!
I'm looking forward to our chat today too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! As an Umamusume of the Mejiro family,
I will surely live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I must give a proper, poised response worthy of the Mejiro name.

The photoshoot proceeded with Mejiro McQueen
acting even more formal and solemn than usual...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-In other words! Fulfilling the Mejiro family's long-cherished wish,
fulfilling it... m-must be accomplished!

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. Such powerful words.
You can really feel the sheer spirit behind them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To everyone, I showed my determined run—
...N-No! I *will* show them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No good.
Responding like this compromises the Mejiro dignity...

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Shall we take a break soon?
I imagine fatigue is starting to set in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'm deeply sorry.

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's a very long shoot, after all!
Please don't worry about it and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The shoot isn't going very well.
And here I thought I was used to it.
choice_data_list: It might be a little stiff.
It might be a little stiff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yes, of course.
I just can't help thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is proof of my resolve and mission.
I want to convey that clearly to everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Besides... for the sake of the fans cheering me on, I must conduct myself in a manner befitting a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that, um...
the words get stuck in my throat.

...She seems far too tense.
It would be best to help her relax right now.
choice_data_list: Let's go for a light run.
Let's have some snacks or something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Even if we're on a break, we are in the middle of a photoshoot, you know!?
My hair will get all messed up...!
choice_data_list: We've got time to get ready! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? J-Jeez...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... How strange.
After that run, both my heart and body feel so much lighter."

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I saw your run just now!
We'd love to air it on the broadcast, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? B-But...
My hair is a mess, and I look so unkempt...

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love for you to do it too! Watching you run,
your passion for running really came through."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes... By all means, please do.
If my feelings can reach them, nothing would make me happier!

—A few days later.
The sight of Mejiro McQueen running with such exhilaration received an overwhelming response.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S-Sweets...!? Heavens no, out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This is an important photoshoot, so I must be in top form.
To think I'd let my guard down with sweets――"
(Gurgle gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez! Alright, I understand.
They do say sweets are good for fatigue, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... Ahh.
The macaron is dancing on my tongue...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, delicious.
It feels as though my body and mind are unwinding.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What a lovely, natural smile!
We'd love to air it on the broadcast, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? M-My face just now!?

text_block_list.name: Female Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"I'd love for you to do it too! That smile of yours
is sure to cheer up all the fans!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood!
If it is to live up to our fans' expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's just, um... I-I'm embarrassed,
so please just make it a tiny bit, okay?

—A few days later.
The sight of Mejiro McQueen nibbling on sweets received an overwhelming response.
